Driver - Renegade 3D.name: Driver: Renegade
Driver - Renegade 3D.summary: Tanner is back and full of rage in the new Driver Renegade for the Nintendo 3DS. Driver Renegade takes place between the stories of Driver 1 and Driver 2. After years of undercover work for the NYPD, John Tanner leaves his badge and takes protection under Senator Ballard to take care of crime in his own way. As a renegade, Tanner cleans up the New York streets and punishes those that oppose him. Driver Renegade brings non- stop 3D car chases to the Nintendo 3DS system.

Kobito Game Taizen.name: Kobito Game Taizen
Kobito Game Taizen.summary:
With 40 different "chibi games", you can enjoy the ecology of Kobitos.
Including rhythm, motion control, puzzles, and more. There are a wide variety of options. Also including Kobito land where you can create your own environment for the Kobitos to enjoy.

Puyo Puyo Tetris.name: Puyo Puyo Tetris
Puyo Puyo Tetris.summary: "Two puzzle game juggernauts collide as Tetris, one of the largest-selling and recognized brands in gaming history, and Puyo Puyo from SEGA have combined to create a fun-to-play, fast-paced, competitive party game like no other! The game has tons of different styles of gameplay – from the single-player Adventure and Challenge modes to the ferocious competition of the up-to-four player Arcade modes. There's plenty of Tetris/Puyo variety, even an in-game Shop where players can unlock new characters, new skins for Puyos and Tetriminos, new backgrounds and more."
